appDescription: Car in Karaoke (카인노래방) is an in-vehicle 4D concert hall and smartphone wireless karaoke app for Pleos Connect.

function.name: PLAY_KARAOKE_SONG
function.description: Search for a karaoke song by keyword or song title, add it to the in-vehicle stage playlist, and immediately start playback.

searchTerm.description: Keyword, song title, artist name, or YouTube URL to search and play in the karaoke stage.

function.name: SET_STAGE_SOUND_MODE
function.description: Configure the in-vehicle 4D karaoke stage sound acoustic preset and optionally toggle the vocal guide melody.

soundPreset.description: Target stage sound acoustic preset mode to apply.

guideVocalEnabled.description: Optional flag to enable or disable the vocal guide melody and pitch synthesis.

function.name: CONTROL_STAGE_PLAYBACK
function.description: Execute playback and pitch key shift control commands on the active karaoke stage.

command.description: Stage playback or key transposition command to execute.
